study_identification_part.si4_title: Molecular and micro-architectural mapping of gray matter alterations in psychosis

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its aims and the purpose of applying normative modeling. They aim to characterize molecular and micro-architectural attributes underlying cortical atypical maturation across psychosis-related groups. They first compute brain volume centiles (age-, sex-, and site-standardized) using an existing normative model, then map these deviations to neurobiological features and analyze associations across conditions.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "We first computed centiles from regional volumes for each group... Next, we investigated the regional vulnerability to psychosis through a multivariate model... Finally, we explored the associations between the interregional vulnerability to psychosis across conditions and the neurobiological similarities."; "centile scores provide a standardized and interpretable metric for detecting alterations in regional volumes"
cm1_research_objectives.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md — Introduction; Methods: Centile and effect sizes estimation and analysis

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: They use an EXISTING normative model (Brain Charts) and explicitly cite the original publication and repository. Per guidance, when using an existing model, the key criterion is to cite the original reference cohort; transfer/recalibration criteria do not apply here as they do not build a new local reference cohort. Image quality and exclusion standards for the normative cohort are documented in the cited original publication.

cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.reason: They define centiles and their directionality (values <0.5 indicate lower GM volume than expected for age and sex). They also define an extreme deviation threshold (centile < 0.05) in the supplement. Clinical implications are discussed via group-wise deviations showing greater impact for clinically diagnosed groups and mapping deviations to neurobiological features.
cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.supporting_text: "Centiles range from 0 to 1, with values below 0.5 indicating that an individual has a lower GM volume than the expected normative values for their age and sex."; "Extremely deviant regions were computed as the relative frequency of individuals (%) with extreme reductions in centile values (centile < 0.05)."; "...identifying deviations in regional volumes below the expected trajectory for all conditions, with a greater impact on the clinically diagnosed ones, FEP and chronic."
